export const hasBody = (method: HttpMethod): method is HttpMethod.WithBody =>
  method !== "GET" && method !== "HEAD" && method !== "OPTIONS" && method !== "TRACE"

notes: Node runtime uses createServer from node:http with NodeHttpServer.layer; browser fixtures launch that CLI under Bun.
Do not invoke toWeb(incoming) before reading incoming.arrayBuffer, because toWeb creates a one-shot stream bridge.
arrayBuffer is canonical, cached, preserves binary data and uses MaxBodySize.
HttpMethod.hasBody omits GET, HEAD, OPTIONS and TRACE, as the old toWeb does.
Hypothesis: streaming bridge lifecycle interacts with Bun Node HTTP before response; baseline has no requestfailed/abort evidence and does not establish this cause.
Candidate is a complete shared-owner proposal only. No remote edit, no product test, no dependency or workflow change.
